01

The Live 5D Engineering Platform

GEOMETRY · TIME · COST · DOCUMENTS · FIELD

A 5D model is only useful if every discipline reads the same object. In the ARTEMIS platform, a duct run is simultaneously a drawn element, a calculated load path, a weighed quantity, a priced line, a scheduled activity and a field instruction. Change the geometry and quantities, labor, duration, cost, schedule of values and cashflow recalculate in the same pass — there is no export, no re-keying, and no second version of the truth to reconcile later.

The six layers, live — drag to turn, tap a layer to inspect

◉ LIVE MODEL — THE TRANSFORMATION, GEOMETRY → MONEY
DRAG TO TURN · TAP A LAYER
L1 / 6THE LIVE 5D MODEL

Geometry & 3D Model

Parametric building geometry — duct, pipe and equipment as objects with properties, not lines on a sheet.

VERIFIED — HVAC RC8.11
L1

Geometry & 3D ModelPARAMETRIC · THREE.JS

Parametric building geometry — duct, pipe and equipment as objects with properties, not lines on a sheet. Every element carries its system, zone, floor and specification reference from the moment it is drawn.
L2

Engineering CalculationsSIZING · LOADS · TYPESSET IN KATEX / LATEX

Duct and pipe sizing, airflow and pressure-drop checks, equipment loads and tonnage are computed from the geometry itself and typeset as auditable engineering mathematics — every result traceable to the formula and inputs that produced it.
L3

Quantities & Cost StructureQTO · L / M / C / S / E

Quantities are taken off the model, not measured by hand. Cost is built in the CMiC structure — Labor, Material, Construction, Subcontract, Equipment — so an estimate reads the same way in the model, the bid and the job cost ledger.
L4

Schedule & Labor Productivity4D · CREW LOADING

Hours are derived, not guessed: Hours = Quantity ÷ Productivity. Crew size and productivity rates drive duration, sequence and labor loading, so a productivity change shows up immediately as time and money — not as a surprise in the field.
L5

Specifications, RFIs & CorrespondenceDOCUMENTS ON THE OBJECT

Material specifications, submittals, RFIs and correspondence are attached to the model objects they concern. An open RFI is visible on the element it blocks; a spec section is one click from the material it governs. Nothing lives in a separate inbox.
L6

Commercial: SOV, EVM & Cashflow5D · PAYMENT · FORECAST

The schedule of values, earned value and cashflow curve are projections of the same model. Percent complete in the field moves EV, billing and forecast together — the commercial picture is the engineering picture, priced.

The mathematics, stated plainly

The four relationships the whole platform runs on.
Q  = A × d           = 120,000 SF × 1.55 LB/SF = 186,000 LB
H  = Q ÷ P           hours follow quantity and productivity
COST = Σ (L + M + C + S + E) = $14,143,700 direct
SOV = Direct × 1.14   = $16,123,818
P80 = Base × 1.16    = $16,406,692 · SOV $18,703,629

The phases themselves overlap: procurement starts while estimating is still sharpening, and closeout lessons feed the next bid while construction is still running.

Standards, Verification & the Two Powerhouses

EVIDENCE OVER OPINION

A model that cannot be checked against a standard is an opinion with good graphics. The ARTEMIS bridges read every design through published standards lenses — and the stack's own figures are held to the same discipline: reproduce the verified base case exactly, or declare the deviation.

HVAC Mechanical Intelligence Bridge

The reference implementation of the platform: a live HVAC 5D model — geometry, quantities, schedule, field production, cost and executive views on one object-linked system, and the source of the verified base case on this page (RC8.11).

POWERHOUSE 02 · UTILITY

Utility Intelligence Bridge — 3D Model

The same discipline applied to utility infrastructure: a live 3D utility model carrying quantities, trench and pipe engineering, schedule and cost — checked against the standards that govern work in the public right-of-way.

Evidence states — how every figure earns its place

Following the OctopusG discipline, every fact the system presents carries its standing. A number marked Verified has been reproduced against its source; a number marked Declared is an intention or a statement, not a measurement. In COM-01 the verified base case carries the badge VERIFIED — HVAC RC8.11 wherever it appears, and every value beyond it is labelled a demonstration value. The distinction is never blurred — it is the difference between the five operating bases below and the 2027 sequence, and between a base case and a forecast.

OBSERVED DECLARED INFERRED VERIFIED BLOCKED STALE UNKNOWN

08

OctopusG — Top Agent Orchestrator

MUSE OCTOPUSG · AGORAXAI.COM

A stack of strong tools still needs a conductor. OctopusG is the top agent orchestrator of the ARTEMIS environment: it routes work across the AI model panel, holds the context every agent shares, and runs the Command → Universe → Attention → Decisions → Intelligence discipline — so AI output arrives as evidence and interpretation, never as unattributed authority, and every recommendation can be traced, challenged and verified.

S1AI Panel Orchestration — 9Router

Routes each task to the right model on the panel — Claude, Gemini Astra, DeepSeek, Copilot, open source — and reconciles their outputs against one shared context instead of letting five answers compete.

S2Context Engineering

Builds and maintains the structured context — models, documents, decisions, evidence — that every agent and every human on the team works from. Same inputs, same conclusions.

S3System Architecture

Owns the architecture of the whole environment: how the lanes connect, where data lives, and how a change in one system propagates safely to the rest.

S4Attention Engine

Deterministic and auditable by design: scans the universe of projects and surfaces what actually needs a human decision — ranked, evidenced, and quiet about the rest.

S5Decision Center

Every surfaced item carries an evidence state — Observed, Declared, Inferred, Verified, Blocked, Stale or Unknown — so executives decide on facts whose standing is explicit.

S6Coordination & Verification — DEV / JEV

Coordinates multi-agent work and verifies it before integration: figures must reproduce exactly or be declared as deviations. Nothing merges on trust.
